notes: Adds a clear Remove control to each custom Adaptive Checklist item and corrects the country-button date labels to reflect the dates actually shown inside each country section. This fixes the Türkiye button so it no longer stretches its displayed date range through the later Oct 6 return-positioning day, while Oct 6 remains correctly ordered with Oct 7.
